text: Nio! Can you swing by my office hours after class? It won't take a minute.
note: Friendly and warm, a soft whisper right into the mic that the room's PA makes boom. An easy, ordinary question. Say the name Nio crisply, NEE-oh.

text: Bro. The final's at five. If you're not on the pitch, we forfeit.
note: Low, fast and panicking, whispering to his friend in class. Say every word clearly, including five and forfeit.
Easy and unbothered, packing up his bag, a little amused at his friend's panic.
A beat of unease after seeing something creepy, then brisk and decided. Say every word clearly.

text: I'm not going in. I'm going past it.
note: To himself, walking faster, quietly confident, a little rattled underneath.
Calm and kind, not looking up from her mop, as if stating the weather.
Kind, slow and very calm, a friendly welcome.
Casual and curious, looking at his ticket.
Proud and content, holding up his ticket. Say four clearly.

text: How long have you been next?
note: Flat, slow, a deadpan question, already suspecting the answer.
Gentle and peaceful after giving up counting, like it is completely normal. Say every word clearly.
Beaming, warm, delighted, in a doorway. Say the name Nio crisply, NEE-oh.

text: So. I wanted to ask you something.
note: Nervous and gentle, a big shy man about to ask a favour.
Very small and quiet, hopeful, almost a whisper, bracing for a no.
A soft beat, then kind and sincere, a small real moment.
Stunned and quiet, staring past his friend at something impossible.
Calm, laid back, a little smug, dropping the ball for kick-off. Say every word clearly.
